chapter.title: SentencePiece Subword Tokenizer
chapter.para: The subword module runs trained SentencePiece models in pure Java, with no native library. SentencePieceTokenizer in the package opennlp.subword.sentencepiece implements the SubwordTokenizer interface from opennlp-api. It supports unigram and byte-pair encoding models, the normalizer stored in the model, and byte fallback. No model is bundled.

section.title: Dependency
section.para: The module needs OpenNLP 3.0.0-M6 or later, the first release with SubwordTokenizer.

section.title: Usage
section.para: Load a SentencePiece .model file. The file holds the vocabulary with piece scores and types, the segmentation algorithm, and the normalizer the model was trained with. The loaded tokenizer is immutable and thread-safe.
SentencePieceUsageExampleTest runs this example. vocabularySize, idToPiece, pieceToId and score inspect the vocabulary, and algorithm reports whether the model uses unigram or byte-pair encoding.
SentencePieceTokenizer also implements OffsetAwareNormalizer. normalize applies the model's normalization rules to any text, and normalizeAligned also returns the alignment to the source text.

section.title: Offsets
section.para: Every non-empty span indexes the input string before normalization, so a model can replace, remove or combine characters without losing the mapping to the source. Control pieces, and continuation bytes that add no source text, have empty spans.

section.title: Model loading and serialization
section.para: Model parsing rejects fields that cross an enclosing message boundary, malformed UTF-8, oversized varints, invalid field numbers and non-ASCII hexadecimal byte pieces.

serialize(OutputStream) writes a Java object stream. deserialize(InputStream) restores it with a fixed class allow-list and resource limits. Both methods close the stream. Only deserialize trusted data: a plain ObjectInputStream does not install this filter.

The default limits are depth 64, 5,000,000 references and 10,000,000 elements per array. The overload that takes DeserializationLimits accepts other positive limits with the same class allow-list. The limits do not cap the total stream size or validate every field of a forged object. To move a model between versions, load it again from its .model file.

section.title: Verification
section.para: The test fixtures compare pieces, ids, spans and normalized text with output from the reference sentencepiece package. SentencePieceAlignmentTest checks the span rules, including supplementary characters, collapsed whitespace and ligature replacement. SentencePieceParityTest checks pieces, ids and spans against the fixtures. The fixture README under subword/src/test/resources/opennlp/subword/sentencepiece describes how the test models were made and how to check published models with -Dopennlp.subword.eval.dir.
